responsibility: Declares default-channel decimal text I/O for SHORTREAL values. It is the standard-channel companion to ShortIO, exposing reads and floating, engineering, fixed, and adaptive-width writes on the current default input and output channels without requiring explicit channel parameters.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the exported specification for default-channel SHORTREAL text I/O, declaring the available read and write routines. It differs from SShortIO.mod, which provides the wrapper implementations that invoke ShortIO on the standard channels.
